summary: Research Army: the tracked link now reaches the post. When you have an offer (an offer named Research Army is used without asking), your agent writes one Auto Plug from the post's own findings and the offer's approved facts with the offer's exact link; it appears in the editable block and on the post card, is scheduled 50 minutes after the post and is read back (a tier-blocked plug is reported, never retried). The post's source line is now always honest: the facts tell Threadify to say "the N most-liked posts from K keyword searches", and a new check-post step fails any post that says top posts, top on Threads, most viewed or most-liked without the searches, or uses a number the checker didn't count, asking Threadify once for a replacement. Pages open with Google Chrome when no browser tool is connected.
